build_argparse_parser_ssl_game: build an argparse parser with data, gumbel softmax, vision, loss, and game architecture options for SSL
create_data_opts_group: create an argument group for dataset directory, name, image size, and dataloader workers
create_gumbel_softmax_opts: create argument group for gumbel softmax temperature, decay, straight through estimator, and update frequency
create_vision_module_opts: create argument group for resnet encoder model name, shared vision, pretrained modules, and augmentations
create_weight_decay_groups: create optimizer parameter groups that separate decay and no-decay params by parameter shape
